context: M1 escort leg 1: Flatiron to Broadway & W 26th, Madison Square Park on the right.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Park's full of guys on benches. Ten years ago we'd have rousted 'em.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Ten years ago they had rooms.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: See, that's your problem. You think about where people sleep.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Remember the toy fellas on Fifth? Christmas, they'd fill the car with dolls.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I remember what was under the dolls.
